fields.description: The company this connection is for.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: The payment provider for this connection. The list shows the providers installed on this site; if yours is not installed yet, you can still type its key. Cannot be changed once the connection is in use.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: The app that provides this gateway. Leave it blank if you are not sure — it will be found from the provider.
fields.label: Gateway app

fields.description: Whether this provider's app is installed and available on this site. Checked every time you save.
fields.label: Registration

fields.description: Why this provider is not available on this site.
fields.label: Registration error

fields.description: How far this setup has got. You can leave it and come back to it. A live connection is edited in place or suspended — it cannot be moved back to draft.
fields.label: State

fields.description: Why this connection is blocked — a failed test, a rule it does not meet, or a refusal from the certifying body.
fields.label: Refusal reason

fields.description: Anything worth recording — for example what you asked your provider for, and when.
fields.label: Note

fields.description: The merchant account this connection tests and takes live. It must be for the same company and provider.
fields.label: Payment Account

fields.description: The address to register with your provider for this connection. Worked out for you and updated every time you save.
fields.label: Callback URL

fields.description: Whether this market requires approval before you can take money. Leave it as unknown only until you have checked — you cannot go live while it is unknown. Your provider's app suggests an answer for each country and payment type it serves.
fields.label: Certification required

fields.description: When the certification requirement last changed after a test had already run. You will need to test again before going live.
fields.label: Requirement changed on

fields.description: Tick to confirm you have seen the change to the certification requirement. Going live stays blocked until this is ticked, and it must be ticked after the change was made.
fields.label: Change acknowledged by the Approver

fields.description: When a settled certification requirement changed after a test had already run.
fields.label: Decided requirement changed on

fields.description: How far certification has got. 'Not required' is a normal answer, not a gap. 'Refused' means the certifying body said no. Whoever can edit this field is also who can take a connection live, suspend it and resume it — that is yours to decide.
fields.label: Certification state

fields.description: When the certification state last changed. Used to work out how long it has been waiting.
fields.label: Since

fields.description: The reason you were given, recorded word for word.
fields.label: Authority's stated reason

lede: Which payment provider's app serves a company's payment rails in a country, and its registration.
name: Payment Connection
